# BrewControl

> BrewControl is a Brazilian web-based ERP and brewery operating system for craft breweries, brewpubs, bars, producers, and gypsy brewers. The product is designed to connect the brewery operation from production and inventory through assets, sales, logistics, finance, fiscal workflows, PDV, and brewpub operations.

Official website: https://brewcontrol.app.br/
Application: https://app.brewcontrol.app.br/
Primary language: Portuguese (Brazil)
Founder: Thiago Schneider

## What BrewControl is

BrewControl is a management system for craft breweries. It is not only a production tool. Its purpose is to reduce parallel spreadsheets and duplicated entries by connecting operational areas in one platform.

Core areas:
- Production: https://brewcontrol.app.br/modulo-producao.html
- Inventory / warehouse: https://brewcontrol.app.br/modulo-almoxarifado.html
- Kegs and assets: https://brewcontrol.app.br/modulo-ativos.html
- Commercial / B2B sales: https://brewcontrol.app.br/modulo-comercial.html
- Logistics: https://brewcontrol.app.br/modulo-logistica.html
- Finance: https://brewcontrol.app.br/modulo-financeiro.html
- Fiscal: https://brewcontrol.app.br/modulo-fiscal.html
- Brewpub and bar: https://brewcontrol.app.br/modulo-brewpub.html
- Mobile POS: https://brewcontrol.app.br/modulo-pdv-mobile.html

## Who it is for

- Craft breweries with their own production
- Brewpubs and bars
- Contract / gypsy brewers
- Producers and beverage operations that need brewery-specific workflows

## Current public pricing

- Bar: BRL 99/month
- Cigano: BRL 129/month
- Produtor: BRL 129/month
- Brewery: BRL 199/month

Official pricing source: https://brewcontrol.app.br/#planos

## Product positioning

Primary positioning: ERP and management system specifically for craft breweries.
Primary value: connect production, inventory, assets, sales, logistics, finance, fiscal flows, and brewpub operations in one operational system.
Design principle: mobile-first for real brewery workflows.
Status: platform in continuous development and tested in real brewery operation.
